inputs.commit_message: Back up partial direct P2P implementation
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
backup=$root/.local/direct-agent-recovery/20260831T200000Z
mkdir -p "$backup"
chmod 700 "$root/.local/direct-agent-recovery" "$backup"
git -C "$root" diff --binary > "$backup/tracked.patch"
chmod 600 "$backup/tracked.patch"
rm -rf "$backup/direct-src"
cp -a "$root/packages/local-agent-core/src/direct" "$backup/direct-src"
find "$backup/direct-src" -type f -exec chmod 600 {} +
printf '%s\n' '--- recovery backup ---'
printf 'path=%s\n' "$backup"
printf 'trackedPatchBytes=%s\n' "$(wc -c < "$backup/tracked.patch")"
printf 'directFiles=%s\n' "$(find "$backup/direct-src" -type f | wc -l)"
printf '%s\n' '--- partial direct filenames ---'
find "$backup/direct-src" -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- tracked diff stat ---'
git -C "$root" diff --stat
printf '%s\n' '--- checksums ---'
sha256sum "$backup/tracked.patch"
find "$backup/direct-src" -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
